- Intersection data: Depth values and other attributes for the $N_{Spec}$ blocks traversed by each ray.
- Termination status: Marks rays that did not hit a surface.

Retrieve the offset $offset = O_{Spec}[r \times N_{Spec} + i]$.
Retrieve the depth $d$ and attributes from the intersection data at $offset$.
Write the attributes from $best\_offset$ to the framebuffer at the pixel corresponding to ray $r$.
